title: Shock Propagation and Macroeconomic Fluctuations
abstract: arXiv:2603.05367v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study how idiosyncratic firm-level shocks generate aggregate volatility and tail risk when they propagate through a production network under overlapping adjustment: new productivity draws arrive before the economy reaches the static equilibrium associated with earlier draws. Each innovation generates a `productivity wave' that mixes and dissipates over time as it travels through the production network. Macroeconomic fluctuations emerge from the interference between these waves of different vintages. The interference between these waves is governed by the dominant transient eigenvalue of the production network, and therefore so are the macroeconomic fluctuations they generate. In such a dynamic regime, the tail of the degree distribution is a markedly weaker determinant of macro fluctuations than in the fully adjusted static benchmark. translated_title: 冲击传播与宏观经济波动
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在企业层面特质性冲击通过生产网络传播时，重叠调整机制如何使这些冲击产生总体波动和尾部风险：新的生产率抽样在经济尚未达到与先前抽样相对应的静态均衡之前就已经到来。每一项创新都会产生一个“生产率波”，该波在穿过生产网络传播的过程中随时间混合并逐渐消散。宏观经济波动正是源于这些不同批次的生产率波之间的干涉。这些波之间的干涉由生产网络的主导暂态特征值所支配，因此它们所引发的宏观经济波动也是如此。在这种动态机制下，度分布的尾部对宏观波动的决定作用明显弱于完全调整的静态基准情形。此外，生产网络度异质性的宏观经济意义无法……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“生产率波”理论，指出在重叠调整机制下，宏观经济波动源于不同批次生产率波通过生产网络传播时的相互干涉，该干涉由网络的主导暂态特征值决定，且在此动态框架中度分布尾部对宏观波动的重要性远低于静态基准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "productivity wave" theory showing that macroeconomic fluctuations emerge from the interference between productivity waves of different vintages propagating through production networks under overlapping adjustment, governed by the dominant transient eigenvalue, with the degree distribution tail being a much weaker determinant of macro fluctuations than in the static benchmark.
